dict.string: Dev Inbox records your side of meetings you choose to record, and transcribes them on this Mac.
Dev Inbox records the call audio of meetings you choose to record, and transcribes them on this Mac.
Dev Inbox shows your meetings in the Day view and timesheet, and reminds you before they start. Nothing is changed in your calendar.
